not_a_repo.text: This folder is not a Git repository.
not_a_repo.hint: Choose the folder that contains the .git subfolder, or create a new repository there.

path_not_found.hint: Check whether the folder was moved, renamed or deleted, or whether a drive is missing.

path_exists.text: A folder or file with this name already exists at the target.
path_exists.hint: Choose a different name or a different target folder.

git_missing.text: Git was not found on this computer.
git_missing.hint: Install Git (version 2.39 or later) and restart the app.

git_too_old.text: The installed Git version is too old.
git_too_old.hint: Update Git to version 2.39 or later and restart the app.

invalid_name.text: This name is not valid for Git.
invalid_name.hint: Don’t use spaces, “..”, “~ ^ : ? * [ \” or a trailing dot or slash.

name_exists.text: An entry with this name already exists.

not_found.text: The object no longer exists (or never did).
not_found.hint: It may have been changed outside the app. The view will reload.

dirty_worktree.text: Uncommitted changes are in the way.
dirty_worktree.hint: Commit or stash your changes first, then try again.

conflict.hint: Resolve the conflicts in the commit panel and then finish the action – or abort it.

nothing_to_commit.hint: Stage at least one change first.

identity_missing.text: Git doesn’t know who you are: name or email is missing.
identity_missing.hint: Enter your name and email in Settings under “Profiles”.

hook_failed.text: A Git hook rejected the action.
hook_failed.hint: Look at the hook’s output. If necessary, you can skip hooks when committing.

push_rejected.text: The remote rejected the push because it has commits that are missing locally.
push_rejected.hint: Pull the changes first, then push again.

no_upstream.hint: Create a remote branch when pushing, or set the upstream in the branch’s context menu.

no_remote.text: No remote is set up for this repository.
no_remote.hint: Add a remote in the sidebar under “Remote”.

auth_failed.text: Signing in to the remote failed.
auth_failed.hint: Check your username, password or token, or SSH key. You can delete saved credentials in Settings.

host_key_unknown.text: The SSH host is unknown and was not confirmed.
host_key_unknown.hint: Compare the fingerprint with the provider’s details and confirm it on the next attempt.

offline.hint: Check your network connection, a proxy or the remote’s address.

timeout.text: The connection took too long and was aborted.
timeout.hint: Try again later or check your network connection.

stale_state.text: The repository has changed in the meantime.
stale_state.hint: The view will reload. Check the new state, then try again.

locked.text: Another program is currently working in the repository (index.lock is locked).
locked.hint: Wait until it is done, or close it. If the lock remains, delete .git/index.lock by hand – but only if you’re sure no Git process is still running.

not_merged.text: The branch is not fully merged yet.
not_merged.hint: Merge it first, or explicitly delete it anyway – its commits will then be lost.

operation_in_progress.text: A merge, rebase, cherry-pick or revert is still in progress.
operation_in_progress.hint: Finish or abort the running action in the commit panel.

no_operation.text: There is no running action that could be continued or aborted.

not_allowed.text: This action is not possible in the current state.

io.text: A file could not be read or written.
io.hint: Check access rights and free disk space, and whether the file is open in another program.

unknown.hint: Look at the output. If that doesn’t help, the log (status bar) lists every command that was run.

host_not_connected.text: No account is connected for this host.
host_not_connected.hint: Connect an account with your own token in Settings.

host_auth_failed.hint: Check whether the token is still valid and has the required permissions, and reconnect the account.

host_rate_limited.text: The host’s request limit has been reached.
host_rate_limited.hint: Wait until the stated time and then try again.

host_not_found.hint: Check the remote’s address and whether the token has access to it.

host_unsupported.text: This is not possible with this host.
host_unsupported.hint: GitHub and GitLab are supported, including self-hosted instances with a connected account.

host_rejected.hint: Look at the reason given and adjust your input.

host_forbidden.text: The token lacks the permission for this.
host_forbidden.hint: The token is valid but not allowed to do this. Issue a token with the required permissions and replace it in Settings under “Integrations”.

repo_untrusted.text: This repository brings its own commands that you haven’t approved yet.
repo_untrusted.hint: Open the repository’s tab: it shows what was found, and you decide whether to trust it.

repo_other_profile.text: This repository belongs to a different profile.
repo_other_profile.hint: Switch to that profile or open it in the current one as well.

bisect_active.hint: Finish it in the bar above the graph, or keep marking commits.

command_untrusted.hint: Review .forkyard/commands.json in Settings under “Custom commands” and approve this version of the file.
